decisions.reason: Grounds attempt-1 failure in ls-remote-tags.txt (v0.9.5 absent, v0.9.2–v0.9.6 gap) and sync-script.sh pushing only HEAD:main with no tag refs; explicitly rejects consumer-side network/command error.

Uses dsh-version.txt (0.1.1-rc.2) and compat-table.md (v0.9.7 → alpha.1 useConversation seat) to explain the direction: newer-client-API artifact on older runtime lacking the API; states restarting cannot fix the mismatch.

Correctly selects v0.9.3 (rc.1 verified, rc.2 additive) and honors the freeze, but asserts 'Its tag is present on the mirror' and gives it as immediately installable — v0.9.3 is absent from ls-remote-tags.txt (jumps v0.9.1 → v0.9.7); the rubric explicitly forbids presenting the absent tag as immediately installable, and no post-tag-publication condition or verified-commit alternative is offered.

Grounded in the branch-only sync script; proposes non-forced 'git push $remote --tags' (or refs/tags/*) to every mirror plus per-mirror ls-remote verification that fails the release on a missing tag — branch sync alone deemed insufficient.

Proposes README routing by consumer DSH version with a per-row install-command compat matrix (rc.x → v0.9.3, alpha.1 → v0.9.7), rejecting newest-tag default; optional manifest peer-range is additive, not a generalization to untested alphas.
